in_hebrew.name: Kin
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Related to the family
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'kinos', meaning 'relation' or 'kindred'. In Christian context, it can symbolize the bond between brothers and sisters in faith and the wider Christian family.

in_greek.name: Kin

in_greek.long_meaning: Kin είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'kinos', meaning 'relation' or 'kindred'. In Christian context, it can symbolize the bond between brothers and sisters in faith and the wider Christian family.

in_latin.name: Kin
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Related to the family
in_latin.long_meaning: Kin est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'kinos', meaning 'relation' or 'kindred'. In Christian context, it can symbolize the bond between brothers and sisters in faith and the wider Christian family.
